name: Monthly Sales Forecast
query:
SELECT
    DATE(close_date) as close_date,
    SUM(CASE WHEN opportunity_type = 'Existing Business' THEN forecast_revenue ELSE 0 END) as existing_business,
    SUM(CASE WHEN opportunity_type = 'New Business' THEN forecast_revenue ELSE 0 END) as new_business
FROM `tabOpportunity`
WHERE YEAR(creation) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(creation) = MONTH(CURDATE())
GROUP BY close_date;
